verdict_reason: Release-level snapshot over 6cef01f854ee4e3c1178791270c9813fa9947730..b02c08712900fff1717622aac666157503ce81de (main's published tip .. develop's new tip). Growth since the superseded e8a0242c ship verdict is exactly PR #254, confirmed by `git log --oneline e8a0242c..b02c0871` -> 3 commits (18f655ca: the git-parents port replacing a single-parent read with a full-parents read plus the merge-commit liveness rule in the verdict-liveness walk; f2290098: the docs-only PR-gate verdict for 18f655ca; b02c0871: the merge commit itself) and `git diff e8a0242c..b02c0871 --stat` -> 16 files, 265(+)/120(-), confined to dadaia_workspace/cli/commands/ci.py, dadaia_workspace/features/chokepoints/{push_gate,verdict}.py, dadaia_workspace/infrastructure/git_objects.py, their unit/contract test siblings, and 3 verdict handoff files under specs/releases/0.4.7/verdicts/ (the superseded 00497199 file deleted, the e8a0242c and 18f655ca files added) -- no surface outside what 18f655ca's own PR-gate verdict already reviewed and approved commit-by-commit (read directly: the parents()/tuple port, the ShaSource/ObjectSource protocol update, the git_objects.py adapter using `git rev-list --parents -n 1 <sha>` with shape-then-list-argv defense before any subprocess call, and the bounded one-hop merged-line walk in live_verdict_shas). Re-ran the release-level checks fresh against this new tip rather than relying solely on the delta: (a) `git diff origin/main..origin/develop --stat | tail -1` -> 411 files changed, 19019(+)/11224(-) (up from 407/18817/11167 at e8a0242c, the +4 files/+202/+57 delta matching PR #254's own stat exactly, no unexplained growth). (b) Secret-pattern grep `(password|passwd|secret|token|api_key|apikey|private_key)\s*=\s*["'][^"']{6,}` over the full main..develop diff -> 1 raw hit: a REMOVED (`-`) line inside a chokepoint denylist-scan test fixture, an AWS-documented non-functional example key literal being replaced by a runtime-composed helper -- the identical, already-disclosed remediation e8a0242c's verdict recorded (DADAIA.md 7.4: a fixture needing a secret shape composes it at runtime, never as a tracked literal); unchanged by PR #254, which touches none of that test file. A private-key-header-shaped grep over the same full diff -> 2 raw hits, both inside verdict-prose text (this range's own e8a0242c handoff, added by 18f655ca's commit) quoting the grep pattern itself as part of the prior scan's own description -- no private-key material, confirmed by direct read of both lines; count and location match e8a0242c's own already-approved disclosure, nothing new introduced by PR #254. (c) `git grep -c -i -E '<sibling-family>' origin/develop -- . ':!specs/bugs/_archive' ':!specs/releases/_archive'` -> 0 matching files (the sibling-family name remains fully absent from the develop tree outside the excluded archive paths, unchanged from e8a0242c). (d) Lockfile: `git diff origin/main..origin/develop -- poetry.lock` -> 0 lines, untouched; `pyproject.toml` diff (42 lines, unchanged from e8a0242c's own review since PR #254 touches no dependency or packaging file) carries only the version bump 0.4.6 -> 0.4.7, a `[tool.poetry.urls]` block of public PyPI/GitHub URLs, a keyword-list edit matching the README, and the relative `[tool.ruff] cache-dir` / `[tool.mypy] cache_dir` redirects under a relative `../../.dadaia/tmp/` path -- no absolute path, no credential, no new dependency source. `.github/workflows/ci.yml` diff (main..develop, 48 lines) is likewise byte-identical to what e8a0242c already reviewed (drops the blanket full-history checkout from three jobs, consolidates backlog-doctor into one dadaia doctor job, redirects mypy's cache via pyproject instead of an inline env var) -- the follow-on Compliance-job fetch-depth fix (commit 6225e866, reviewed separately under its own PR-gate verdict) has not yet merged into develop and is correctly absent from this diff. No production dependency version changed anywhere in the range. No IaC file (Dockerfile/compose/Terraform/Pulumi) touched. Prior verdict chain, each covering a sub-range of this same span, all APPROVED, cited rather than re-derived in full: e214a463 (candidate 4 PR-gate), 62369eb9 (candidates 2-4 PR-gate), 448d365e (delta re-verdict), 00497199 (delta re-verdict), and this session's own 18f655ca PR-gate delta verdict (the git-parents/liveness-rule fix, read in full above and in that verdict's own record: shape-then-list-argv defense confirmed, no shell-injection surface, one-hop-bounded merged-line walk confirmed, no expansion of trust beyond dd-gitflow-default's documented two-hop rule). No CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM finding anywhere in the range. No live credential, no PII, no auth/access-control regression identified. Snapshot, not a guarantee of 'secure' (DADAIA.md 7.5) -- the operator owns the ship decision.
